import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu

# 1. Load dataset and filter for task_id=103
df = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df_103 = df[df['task_id'] == 103].dropna(subset=['QED_delta', 'murcko_scaffold_retained'])

# 2. Split into retained vs non-retained groups
group_ret = df_103[df_103['murcko_scaffold_retained'] == True]['QED_delta']
group_non = df_103[df_103['murcko_scaffold_retained'] == False]['QED_delta']

# 3. Descriptive statistics
stats = {
    'Group': ['Retained', 'Non-retained'],
    'Count': [len(group_ret), len(group_non)],
    'Mean': [group_ret.mean(), group_non.mean()],
    'Median': [group_ret.median(), group_non.median()],
    'Std': [group_ret.std(), group_non.std()]
}
stat_df = pd.DataFrame(stats)
print("Summary statistics of QED_delta by scaffold retention (task 103):")
print(stat_df.to_string(index=False))

# 4. Statistical tests
# Welch's t-test
t_stat, t_p = ttest_ind(group_ret, group_non, equal_var=False)
# Mann-Whitney U test
u_stat, u_p = mannwhitneyu(group_ret, group_non, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nWelch's t-test: t-statistic = {t_stat:.4f}, p-value = {t_p:.4e}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U-statistic = {u_stat:.4f}, p-value = {u_p:.4e}\n")

# 5. Visualization: boxplot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='murcko_scaffold_retained', y='QED_delta', data=df_103, palette='Set2')
plt.xlabel('Murcko Scaffold Retained')
plt.ylabel('QED_delta')
plt.title('QED_delta by Scaffold Retention for Task 103')
plt.xticks([0, 1], ['Non-retained', 'Retained'])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
